text:
eval-bot: Nightly eval results are in for redwood-3b-v2-quant. Regression: +4.6% failure rate on prompt_set_adfs vs baseline. Metric: exact-match down. Suspected sampling-related drift.

maria_ml: @eval-bot do we have per-run sampling params and seeds attached? :eyes:

eval-bot: yes — payload includes config blob. Sample: {"temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.9, "top_k": 50, "seed": null} for latest run.

ajay: seed:null is suspicious — that means nondeterministic sampling across nightly workers. Could explain variance.

sylvie: we rolled a default sampling overrides PR yesterday: infra/devex#412 changed default top_k from 40->50 and set top_p to 0.9 when unspecified. I called it "safer-diversity" but didn't think nightly evals would pick it up until deployment window.

maria_ml: that PR also touched the RNG init in the sampler, right? @sylvie

sylvie: yep, added `if seed is None: seed = os.urandom(8)` in sampler init.

tim_eng: whoa — that will absolutely make runs non-reproducible. Nightly eval infra assumes seed=42 fallback.

ajay: quick repro command to run locally:```python
from redwood_inference import Model
m = Model('redwood-3b-v2-quant')
print(m.generate('Translate: Hello', temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9, top_k=50, seed=42))
```

maria_ml: I'll run the nightly eval harness with both seeds: None vs 42 and compare diffs.

eval-bot: run metadata: nightly-2026-03-19T03:12Z includes config hash 8f9d3 and sampler_version v1.14.

ajay: also watch out for quantization nondeterminism on older CUDA drivers — small FP rounding can amplify sampling differences. Any infra changes last night?

ops-bot: deploy log: cluster/gpu-pool-3: kernel driver updated to 535.54 at 02:45 UTC.

maria_ml: ok combining info: sampler default change + kernel driver bump + RNG null seeds -> plausible root cause triad.

sylvie: plan: revert default RNG change in sampler (hotfix), add explicit nightly eval config to set seed=42, and add unit test that asserts determinism for seed=42 across quantized kernels.

ajay: also add telemetry: log effective sampling params (temp/top_p/top_k/seed) in eval outputs so we don't rely on external blobs. Minimal patch:```diff
- if seed is None: seed = os.urandom(8)
+ if seed is None: seed = os.environ.get('DEFAULT_EVAL_SEED') or 42
```

tim_eng: I'll open a PR for the revert+test and link here. Assign to @sylvie for review and @maria_ml for eval harness change.

maria_ml: running focused job now, will post results here in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eval-bot: adhoc-run results posted: exact-match drop disappears when seed=42 and top_k=40 (baseline). With seed=None and top_k=50 failure clusters spike in paraphrase prompts.

sylvie: thanks — confirms. I'll roll the hotfix to canary then prod.

maria_ml: follow-ups: add a nightly assertion that sampling params must match the baseline config, and add a short note in model-onboarding checklist about explicit sampling seeds for evals.

ajay: small reminder: sampling defaults are a product decision too. We should discuss before changing defaults that affect evals.

maria_ml: agreed. tagging this thread for postmortem notes. Closing after hotfix and updated tests. :white_check_mark:
